properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.enabled
properties.description: Whether GPULlama3 chat auto-configuration is enabled when the local model path is configured.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.model-path
properties.description: Path to the local GGUF model file. GPULlama3 chat auto-configuration activates only when this property is set.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.model
properties.description: Optional model name reported in chat responses. When unset, the GGUF file name is used.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.on-gpu
properties.description: Whether to use the GPU execution path. The default is false because GPU execution requires the appropriate TornadoVM launch environment.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.context-length
properties.description: Maximum context length used when loading the local model.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.options.max-tokens
properties.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate for each request.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.options.top-p
properties.description: Nucleus sampling probability used during generation.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.options.stop-sequences
properties.description: Portable Spring AI option retained for API compatibility. GPULlama3 currently ignores it and uses model-defined stop tokens.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.options.top-k
properties.description: Portable Spring AI option retained for API compatibility. GPULlama3 currently ignores it because its sampler does not expose top-k sampling.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.options.frequency-penalty
properties.description: Portable Spring AI option retained for API compatibility. GPULlama3 currently ignores it because its sampler does not expose frequency penalties.

properties.name: spring.ai.gpullama3.chat.options.presence-penalty
properties.description: Portable Spring AI option retained for API compatibility. GPULlama3 currently ignores it because its sampler does not expose presence penalties.
